text:
Rowan: dropping a fresh take on the roles matrix — aim: speed up scan + reduce visual noise for big orgs.

Priya: Nice. Suggest collapsing long descriptions into short tags and exposing details via an explicit 'Details' button (not hover).

Diego: Agree. Accessibility: Details must be keyboard reachable (use button aria-controls + aria-expanded). If we lazy-load details, include an sr-only summary in DOM.

Lina: SSO control copy: current line is too wordy. Proposal: 'Enforce SSO  recommended.' Add a small "View SSO events" link next to it that opens the audit with a pre-applied filter.

Rowan: Good. Where to place the audit link? Inline by the toggle and also keep the top-right audit link. Redundancy helps.

Priya: When toggling SSO on, we show a confirmation panel. It should receive focus (programmatic focus on h2 with tabindex=-1) and the primary button should read 'Start SSO rollout'. Esc should close the panel.

Diego: Engineering note: animate expand (160ms), call focus after animationend, debounce rapid toggles, and add an aria-live region announcing success/failure.

Lina: Modal copy: start with a one-line summary and a 1-2 bullet list. Include: 'Audit events recorded as "sso.enforce"'.

ops-bot: Reminder: audit events are indexed with event_type = sso.enforce. Deep-link pattern: /orgs/:id/audit?filter=event_type%3Asso.enforce

Rowan: Action items: Priya  a11y checklist for details + panel; Diego  prototype focus timing and deep-link; Lina  update copy and mock; I'll coordinate a 5-user quick test next week.

Priya: Also ensure tooltips are not the only way to convey status; include visible text and accessible names.

Diego: I'll post a short recording of the focus flow once prototyped.

Lina: Uploaded mock: https://figma.redwood.com/file/mock-roles-compact
